name: Esaka Miyuki
source:
Despite still being young, she is a beautiful, gentle-looking woman who runs a mobile melon bread shop with her daughter, Rie.

Contrary to her appearance, she is a very proactive woman who speaks up when she needs to, but she is also quick-witted and reads the mood well. However, she often ends up reading the mood too much and ends up getting carried away by the situation before she realizes it. Her kind-hearted nature and her inability to leave people in trouble alone also contribute to making the situation worse.

In reality, she is not related to her daughter, Rie, by blood; she was the only child of her older sister and her husband, who died in a traffic accident at a young age, and she has taken her in and raised her with love as if she were her own daughter.

Not only is she a certified confectionery hygiene technician, but she also once trained as an apprentice pastry chef at a hotel. When she was offered the responsibility of a larger store, she turned it down out of consideration for Rie and opened her current mobile melon bread shop. However, there is still a part of her that cannot completely give up on her dreams.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140819084648/http://www.turumiku.jp/matsuba/Miyuki.html] official site, archived[/url]]
